description: This file is a shell script that manages reboot conditions based on firmware upgrade timing, including reading and setting maintenance window times, calculating current time, and removing scheduled reboot tasks.

methods.name: ExtractMaintenanceTime
methods.description: Extracts firmware upgrade start and end times from system files or sets default values.

methods.name: ExtractcurrentTime
methods.description: Calculates current time components, accounts for UTC or local time, and logs times.

methods.name: Removecron
methods.description: Removes the AutoReboot schedule from the system crontab.
